name: Serenite
source:
A young man who is a church priest. Generous and kind. He behaves equally and kindly towards everyone. He sometimes appears before the protagonists and gives her advice. Something about him makes him seem otherworldly. 

"Yes, this is the Church of the Yellow Country. And I am the priest of this church, Serenite. Pleased to make your acquaintance."

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
